description: This file defines the ExtensionMimeTypeGuesser class, which implements the MimeTypeGuesserInterface to determine MIME types based on file extensions.

classes.name: ExtensionMimeTypeGuesser
classes.description: A class that guesses the MIME type of a file based on its extension, implementing the MimeTypeGuesserInterface.

methods.name: isGuesserSupported
methods.description: Indicates that this MIME type guesser is supported and can be used.

methods.name: guessMimeType
methods.description: Guesses the MIME type of a file given its path, based on common extensions such as css and js.
